title: Aristotle and Dante Discover the Secrets of the Universe
author: Benjamin Alire Sáenz
summary: In 1980s El Paso, two Mexican-American teenagers become friends over a summer, and then through everything that follows. The book follows their families, their questions and the slow process of understanding themselves.
readIf: you like a lyrical, quiet, character-led coming-of-age story with tender, thoughtful dialogue.
skipIf: you want fast plotting or lots of action.

pairings.reason: A more comic, easy-going teen story of a boy coming to terms with who he loves.
Another gentle, 1980s-flavoured YA love story told with honesty.
A sensitive, introspective teen narrator who finds friends and some healing.
